verdict.rationale: Fathom ships an official MCP server and official connectors for Claude/ChatGPT, letting users query and interact with meeting data via natural-language prompts in those assistants, and lists a 'Conversational meeting assistant' as a product feature — both are corroborated by live runtime probes of the MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface (e.g., voice/text commands to control Fathom itself rather than just query data through third-party assistants), and independent user reports of successful conversational task execution beyond data retrieval.
